# The Great Media

> The Great Media is an advertising agency in Lusaka, Zambia, founded in 2023 by Ephraim Banda and registered with PACRA. It helps businesses scale with Meta ads (Facebook and Instagram), custom-built systems (websites, online stores, software) and AI automation.

## What it does
- Meta ads: Facebook and Instagram campaigns managed for enquiries and sales, with tracking from click to sale. https://thegreatmediazm.com/facebook-ads-zambia
- Google Ads: search campaigns for Zambian businesses. https://thegreatmediazm.com/google-ads-zambia
- TikTok ads: short video ad campaigns. https://thegreatmediazm.com/tiktok-ads-zambia
- Website design: fast, mobile-first websites, landing pages and online stores. https://thegreatmediazm.com/website-design-zambia
- Custom software: web apps and business systems such as SchoolFlow (school management), GymFlow (gym management) and Sitolo (point of sale). https://thegreatmediazm.com/software-development-zambia
- AI automation: AI assistants that reply to enquiries in seconds, qualify leads and follow up. https://thegreatmediazm.com/ai-automation-zambia

## Results
- Cutrite Windows & Glass: K100,000+ in client-reported sales from Facebook and Instagram enquiries.
- Janice Wigs: 50+ wigs sold in two months from social media ads (client-reported).
- 15 live websites, apps and systems, listed at https://thegreatmediazm.com/results

## How to work with The Great Media
New clients apply through a short qualifying form at https://thegreatmediazm.com/apply. The agency takes on a maximum of three new clients a month. It is best suited to established businesses where one customer is worth real money. Prices are not published; accepted applicants receive a fixed proposal.
